reason: Shentel sells fiber/cable broadband, TV and phone service to residential households and businesses in regional US markets. TDS Telecom sells the same bundle (fiber internet, TV and phone) to residential and business customers in small to mid-sized US communities. Both earn recurring subscription revenue from networks they own. TDS also has wireless and tower operations. These go beyond Shentel's core, but Shentel's core is fully covered, so the extra lines don't lower the grade.
